status.summary: On 29 September 2026 CloudHQ presented Project Asahi, its plan for the full redevelopment of BIG HOP Garden Mall Inzai beside Inzai Makinohara Station, to the Inzai City Council plenary briefing; the city published the deck the same day. Its site plan places two new data-centre blocks with office space on the mall site alongside rebuilt retail, a community park and future-development plots, and the city records that the operator is considering co-locating data centres on the site to fund the rebuilding of the commercial facility. This supports an announced project only: the city's notice says the plan is at an early stage with no prior consultation or permit procedure with the city, construction timing is undecided (the operator's mid-2030s operating target is a target, not a stage), no capacity or floor area is published, and the city's restrictive district-plan revision for this station area is still undecided.

locator.precision: Centroid of MOJ registry-map lot 原一丁目2-1, the roughly 13.3 ha BIG HOP Garden Mall Inzai parent property that Project Asahi redevelops. It does not locate either planned data-centre block (south-centre of the site on CloudHQ's plan), a building footprint, phase boundary, entrance or construction extent.

Inzai City's 29 September briefing map and CloudHQ's Gensler site plan both show the BIG HOP block west of the station with existing data centres in its south-west corner, matching lots 2-2/2-3; a qualitative overlay on GSI seamless aerial tiles puts the mall building inside lot 2-1. The new data-centre blocks fall inside lot 2-1, not on the existing south-west plot.

The record remains Approved, at the Pre-Construction Meeting stage. Demolition, site work, building construction, completion and operation are not established, and building permits were not reviewed.
